item.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
item.description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

item.title: Many Americans have no memory of 9/11. A foundation hopes an artifact can change that
item.description: The Tunnels to Towers Foundation is traveling across the U.S. with a 21-foot I-beam from the World Trade Center's South Tower to help educate Americans with no memory of the Sept. 11 attacks.
item.content:encoded: The Tunnels to Towers Foundation is traveling across the U.S. with a 21-foot I-beam from the World Trade Center's South Tower to help educate Americans with no memory of the Sept. 11 attacks.

item.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
item.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

item.title: Federal aviation investigators look into deadly Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
item.description: Federal aviation investigators are searching for answers following a deadly cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport Sunday that killed five people and injured at least five others.

item.title: Trump administration mulls renaming USS Doris Miller
item.description: The Trump administration is considering stripping the name of an African American war hero from an aircraft carrier, even though President Trump himself praised the honor in his first term.
